dedupe_keys.name: energy consumption of refugees and displaced people modelled cooking and lighting energy use with access scenarios moving energy initiative hdx

description: This Humanitarian Data Exchange dataset from the Moving Energy Initiative estimates energy consumption for cooking and lighting by refugees and displaced people, a group the page says is often left out of national energy access figures. It was built with an end-use accounting model and includes three high-level scenarios for improving access to cooking and lighting energy. The CSV files split consumption by setting (urban, slum, rural, camp and small camp) and add population and key figure tables, including a disaggregated version. It is free to download under the CC BY-IGO licence and was published in September 2018 without later updates. Coverage is global. Caveats: the figures are modelled, not metered, the page does not detail the model assumptions, and the publishing initiative is now marked inactive on HDX. Simulation uses are baseline demand and access scenarios for displaced populations in energy planning studies. Related records: data-nyabiheke-camp-minigrid-hourly-consumption gives metered camp loads and data-safe-energy-projects-humanitarian-settings lists energy projects in humanitarian settings.
